missing.title: Chart details are incomplete.
missing.lead: Return to intake and provide complete birth details before opening the divisional chart atlas.

unavailable.title: The divisional charts could not be prepared.
unavailable.fallback: No divisional chart data was returned.

hero.heading: {name}'s divisional chart layers
hero.lead: The D1 is the foundation. Each higher varga magnifies one life area, helping the reading confirm, qualify, or narrow a theme already present in the main chart.

reliability.label: Birth time reliability
reliability.goodBody: The atlas can display every supported varga. D30 and D60 still deserve boundary checks because their divisions are exceptionally fine.
reliability.cautionTitle: Use higher divisions as exploratory layers
reliability.cautionBody: The recorded time is approximate or a fallback. Planetary sign subdivisions are shown, but ascendant- and house-based conclusions in higher vargas should not be promoted until the birth time is rectified.

important.heading: Start with the charts that answer a clear question
important.lead: These ten receive fuller guidance because they add the most useful context to a client-focused reading. They are not ten competing natal charts.

complete.heading: All calculated vargas
complete.lead: Select any chart to inspect the client's placements. The ten key charts include additional interpretation guidance below.

detail.traditionNote: Outside Parashara’s sixteen vargas — read as a supplementary layer, not a classical authority.
detail.secondaryNote: This is a supporting chart in the complete atlas. It can add context, but the report should promote it only when the D1 and a relevant key varga already support the same conclusion.

positions.heading: {label} position map
positions.note: “Repeats” means the point remains in the same sign as D1. It is a consistency signal, not automatically positive or negative.

atlas.footer: Divisional charts increase specificity only when they confirm the natal promise, use reliable birth data, and agree with independent strength and timing factors.

panel.heading: Divisional Charts
panel.intro: D1 is the natal foundation; the remaining charts magnify specific life themes by subdividing each sign. Select a chart below to see where each planet lands in that division.
panel.hint: Planets in the same sign as their rashi position are highlighted. This repetition strengthens that planet's expression in the corresponding life area. D5, D6, D8, and D11 use extended traditional mappings; they sit outside the classical sixteen Parashari vargas.

themes.d1: Overall life, identity, and the natal foundation
themes.d6: Health patterns, routines, and everyday obstacles
themes.d11: Gains, networks, and the fulfillment of ambitions
themes.d60: Past life karma and general matters

errors.missingBody: Return to intake and provide the complete birth details before opening the {label} {name} analysis.
errors.unavailableTitle: The {name} detail could not be prepared.
errors.unavailableBody: {label} was not returned by the chart calculation.

reliability.note: Boundary distance below describes proximity to the source-rashi subdivision; it is not a probability or a favorable/unfavorable score.

glance.heading: The chart facts before interpretation
glance.note: A D1 sign recurrence is a consistency marker only. It is not automatically positive, strong, or predictive.

map.heading: {label} South-Indian-style chart
map.invalidAscendant: A valid divisional ascendant was not returned, so house placement is withheld.
map.note: This map derives whole-sign houses from the divisional ascendant. It does not infer exact aspects or replace the natal house system.

placements.heading: Points connected to this chart's focus
placements.strengthNote: Independent natal delivery strength; this is not a {label} dignity score.

table.heading: Every calculated point
table.caption: {label} positions compared with D1, including whole-sign house, sign lord, dignity, recurrence, and source subdivision boundary distance.
table.note: Classical dignity is shown only for the seven classical planets. No dignity is assigned here to the Ascendant, Rahu, or Ketu. Boundary distance is measured from each point's natal degree to the nearest subdivision edge.

timing.heading: Dasha lords inside {label}
timing.dashaUnavailable: Current dasha data was not returned.
timing.note: An active period increases timing relevance; it does not make a placement automatically favorable. Read it with D1, measured strength, and lived evidence.

method.heading: How this page was calculated
method.vargaHouseDisplayValue: Whole-sign houses derived from the {label} Ascendant
method.cautionBody: This page reports calculated signs, whole-sign houses, rulers, classical dignity, and timing-lord location. It does not infer exact divisional aspects, treat sign recurrence as automatically positive, or let {label} override D1.

footer.note: Divisional charts refine a natal promise; they do not replace it. Stronger conclusions require reliable birth data and agreement with independent evidence.
